about: got what they wanted and cried
answers: I'm fine. Honestly. Well. No. I don't know.
I got the thing I wanted, the place in the program, and I cried the whole way home and not happy crying. Or maybe happy. I can't tell.
Like it's too big. Like I don't deserve it, and also I want it so much.
I want to stop deciding what it means. Just let it be both.
